tokens.npc_dota_hero_treant_bio:
Far to the west, in the mountains beyond the Vale of Augury, lie the remains of an ancient power, a fount of eldritch energy nestled deep in the high woods. It is said that the things that grow here, grow strangely. To the forces of nature this is a sacred place, made to stay hidden and unknown. Many are the traps and dangers of this land. There are all-consuming grasses, crossbred fauna and poisonous flowers, but none are so fierce as the mighty Treant Protectors.

These ageless, titanic beings, charged with keeping the peace in this dangerous land, ensure that none within encroach without reason, and none without poach their secrets. For time untold they tended to their holy ground, uninterrupted, only dimly aware of the changing world beyond. Yet inevitably the wider world grew aware of this untamed land, and with each passing winter the outsiders grew bolder. Soon they arrived with tools to cut and with flames to burn, and often the Treants would ponder: who are these fragile, industrious creatures? What now had become of the wild, green world? There came and went an age of questions and of doubts, a thousand summers of long traditions set to scrutiny, while more and more the outsiders died and fed their earth.

When all that bloomed had finally finished their say, curiosity had overcome caution. It was decided: a lone Protector would be sent into the wider world, and instructed to wander until the glaciers arose once more, to observe the changing land and its creatures, and to discover what unknown dangers could threaten their sacred ground.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_treant_hype: Treant Protector is ever the benevolent ally, sprouting regenerating armor for his cohorts and their fortifications alike. Emerging unseen from among the trees, he binds foes with overgrowth as he leeches health from enemies and into nearby allies.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This {{M|innate}} ability in the {{Spellslot|5|6}}.
** [[File:Treant Protector Nature's Guise (Inactive) abilityicon dota2 wikiasset.png|21px]]
*** In short, the ability becomes inactive and does not grant any ability effects during its downtime.
*** During its downtime, each incoming {{Code|> {{#var:Nature's Guise value2}}-damage instance}} taken ([[Damage Manipulation|after all reductions]]) from the following sources refreshes the downtime, regardless of valid trees within the tree search radius:
**** Player-based damage regardless of {{M|factions}}.
**** {{U|Roshan}}
**** Any damage instance not flagged as {{M|HP Removal}}.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Grants Treant {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|treant_natures_guise_tree_walking}} when the following conditions are fulfilled:
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
*#** When the ability is not on its downtime.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Trees}}
*#** When the following valid [[tree]] sources are within the tree search radius:
*#*** Natural {{M|trees}}.
*#*** {{M|Planted trees}}.
*#*** Allied {{A|Treant Protector|Nature's Guise}} vines.
*# {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* The ability is considered active.
*#* Treant now has the following additional properties, with the following ability effects, within the tree search radius:
*#** Can perform '''any''' actions without losing the ability effects.
*#** Taking damage neither disable the ability effects nor puts the ability in downtime.
*#* Grants the following bonuses while active:
*#** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|treant_natures_guise_tree_walking}}
*#*** {{M|Tree-walking}}
*#*** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
*#**** Treant still retains his {{Symbol|bonus day}} [[daytime]] and {{Symbol|bonus night}} [[nighttime]] [[vision]] values while the buff is active.
*#** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|treant_natures_guise_invis}}
*#*** {{M|Phase movement}}.
*#*** {{M|Invisibility}} with the following properties:
*#**** Utilizes a buff linger duration that relies on the tree search radius, instead of a {{M|fade delay}}.
*#***** The buff linger duration has an indicator on the [[HUD]].
*#**** Breaks invisibility upon Treant's {{M|attack point}}.
*#* {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
*#** The ability [[cooldown]] starts upon losing the buff in any way, not upon cast.
*#** Does not reduce the ability's current cooldown value immediately upon leveling up.

* {{cf|expr}}
** Ability {{M|cooldown}}: {{Code|{{#var:Nature's Guise cd}} - ({{#var:Nature's Guise basic1}} × SelfLvl)}}

data.name: npc_dota_hero_treant
data.bio_loc:
Far to the west, in the mountains beyond the Vale of Augury, lie the remains of an ancient power, a fount of eldritch energy nestled deep in the high woods. It is said that the things that grow here, grow strangely. To the forces of nature this is a sacred place, made to stay hidden and unknown. Many are the traps and dangers of this land. There are all-consuming grasses, crossbred fauna and poisonous flowers, but none are so fierce as the mighty Treant Protectors.

These ageless, titanic beings, charged with keeping the peace in this dangerous land, ensure that none within encroach without reason, and none without poach their secrets. For time untold they tended to their holy ground, uninterrupted, only dimly aware of the changing world beyond. Yet inevitably the wider world grew aware of this untamed land, and with each passing winter the outsiders grew bolder. Soon they arrived with tools to cut and with flames to burn, and often the Treants would ponder: who are these fragile, industrious creatures? What now had become of the wild, green world? There came and went an age of questions and of doubts, a thousand summers of long traditions set to scrutiny, while more and more the outsiders died and fed their earth.

When all that bloomed had finally finished their say, curiosity had overcome caution. It was decided: a lone Protector would be sent into the wider world, and instructed to wander until the glaciers arose once more, to observe the changing land and its creatures, and to discover what unknown dangers could threaten their sacred ground.
data.hype_loc: Treant Protector is ever the benevolent ally, sprouting regenerating armor for his cohorts and their fortifications alike. Emerging unseen from among the trees, he binds foes with overgrowth as he leeches health from enemies and into nearby allies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Calls upon the forest to root his foes

abilities.name: treant_natures_grasp
abilities.desc_loc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.

abilities.name: treant_leech_seed
abilities.desc_loc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
abilities.lore_loc: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.
facets_loc: Leech Seed can be ground targeted, planting a tree that heals allies and damages all enemies in the effect radius for the duration of the ability. Damage to creeps is reduced by %creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%. If the tree is cut down, it immediately re-grows again.

abilities.name: treant_living_armor
abilities.desc_loc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
abilities.lore_loc: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.
notes_loc: Instances of damage less than %damage_block_threshold% are ignored.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for %passive_reset_cd% seconds.

abilities.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
abilities.desc_loc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
abilities.lore_loc: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.
notes_loc: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

abilities.name: treant_natures_guise
abilities.desc_loc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
abilities.lore_loc: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.
notes_loc: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

abilities.name: treant_overgrowth
abilities.desc_loc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
abilities.lore_loc: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.
notes_loc: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.
abilities.scepter_loc: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
